discussion.body: SET-1.2 Selection, transform, professional inspector values — impl status: built, not done (gates). Move/resize/rotate handles commit on pointer-up. Inspector values: type, name, x, y, rotation, scale, lock, hide, layerId read-only, order read-only. Snap to frame corners, edge midpoints, and centers. Undo/redo for create, delete, transform, props. How to verify: zoom in, draw, select, nudge x/y in the inspector, undo — field matches the numbers. Not done: gates BUG-001 (fixed, not verified) and SET-1.1 (not marked done).
